name: The Queen's Tear
introDiscord:
A beautiful fountain dominates the Queen's courtyard.

Water rises from it despite the surrounding sea, forming a perfect
silver tear that never disperses.
introTwitch:
A beautiful fountain dominates the Queen's courtyard.

Water rises from it despite the surrounding sea, forming a perfect
silver tear that never disperses.

the-queens-tear-approach.prompt: The Queen's Tear opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message: A small offering bowl contains Star Candies.

right.message:
The fountain water restores strength.

Shizuki wrote:

'Very pretty.

Made wish.

Glimmer says I already used wish at first fountain.

I reject this restriction.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Queen's Tear Elemental rises from the silver water.

the-queens-tear-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Queen's Tear, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message: An Elemental forms beneath the fountain arches.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath Wish #2:

'Unlimited berries.

Wish #1 also unlimited berries.

Consistency matters.'

forward.message: A royal offering chest contains Star Candies.

the-queens-tear-threshold.prompt: Near Lamentation Basin, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A pearl bowl contains Star Candies.

right.message: An Elemental rises from Lamentation Basin.

forward.message:
Shizuki's final fountain note:

'Maybe this wasn't built because somebody was sad.

Maybe it was built because somebody wanted something beautiful.

I like that better.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Lamentation Basin
boss-antechamber.prompt: The silver tear expands across the basin.

bossPromptDiscord:
The silver tear expands across the basin.

A regal figure forms within the flowing water.

Use /yes to approach or /no to leave the Queen's fountain
undisturbed.
bossPromptTwitch:
The silver tear expands across the basin.

A regal figure forms within the flowing water.

Use !yes to approach or !no to leave the Queen's fountain
undisturbed.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Lamentation Basin. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The figure dissolves back into the fountain.

The silver tear remains.

Still beautiful.
